Home keeps what it heard in it.", under Deleted and Audio deleted chips; Show more is not offered while a filter's read is on its way.

gray: Whether deleted takes show among the rest, and whether a chip counts what is shown or all home keeps, is what the owner sees and no check settles it.
undo: Filter status deleted and recording-let-go out in TakeLibrary's homeRows; dispatch no query on a chip or order to filter only what's shown.
